Moves an Digital Assistant instance into a different compartment. When provided, If-Match is checked against ETag values of the resource. 
[Command Reference](changeOdaInstanceCompartment)
records: Identifier of the compartment into which the Digital Assistant instance should be moved. [required]

The service updates or deletes the instance only if the etag that you provide matches the instance's current etag value.

Check every --wait-interval-seconds to see whether the work request has reached the state defined by --wait-for-state. Defaults to 30 seconds.
